summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO prototype whose title and character-creation places lead into the streamed Lantern March continent. MMORPG Tools owns the front door, character lifecycle and modular UI; ordered player behaviors compose movement, class combat, quests and trade, while procedural builders and terrain bindings supply settlements, landmarks and painted vegetation.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - title/front door and Realm Gate backdrop; menu camera, realm roster and character UI live here.
places/character-creation-land/ - Wayshrine character preview/create scene with its own atmosphere and look.
places/main/ - streamed Lantern March continent; config owns terrain/coast, roads, scatter, atmosphere and start-zone clearings.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach hub, buildings, services, residents and local interactions.
places/main/cells/ - continent cells hold Briarwild, Emberstone Quarry, farms, settlements, race starts and distant landmarks.
places/main/cells/x-6z1.scene, x7z-1.scene and x2z11.scene - Thornhollow, Cinderhold and Gullrest starts; Gullrest's campfire, benches, net rack and signpost sit on its village green below the bluff.

places/main/cells/x-28z0.scene - Elderveil Wilds giant-tree landmark at (-3600,-60); its roots are now a separate frontier-elderveil-roots placed object with bark material, beside tree and shelf pieces.
roots: world.config.yaml - main-menu-land default entry; binds player/camera, MMORPG UI, nametag, arrival behavior, routing and realm pulse.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod.json - registers MMORPG player/menu, character creation, camera and interaction behaviors.
templates/player.js#player - ordered chain: humanoid locomotion, core movement, Vanguard, Arcanist, Pathfinder, quest-player and vendor.
templates/camera.js#camera - core camera template using scripts/camera.js; MMORPG orbit, creation-preview and menu framing are separate paths.
places/main/config.yaml - continent spawn, gravity, terrain/coast, material layers, roads, flattening and terrain scatter bindings.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG data registries, persistence helpers and UI panels consumed by mod behaviors and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - per-realm character SQL load/upsert/delete and roster population used by menu and player lifecycle.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-art.js - shared Gothic/brass frames and rules reused by menu panel renderers and HUD/menu chrome.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - room roster read by scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js; realm-save.js separately defines its roster in code.
scripts/lib/economy.js and MMORPG lib/currency.js - copper transactions/ledger and currency formatting shared by gameplay, vendor and UI.
scripts/lib/data/quests.yml, townsfolk.yml and wolves.yml - quest, dialogue and pack definitions read by their gameplay behaviors.
scripts/lib/regions.js and scripts/terrain-reach.js - continent region classification and height/coast functions used by terrain and region display.
scripts/gen/shape.js and gen/house.js, hamlet.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, farm.js, windmill*, frontier.js, briar.js, quarry.js and reach-* - shared procedural geometry builders.
notableExports: scripts/routing.js - pickRoom; crons/realm-pulse.js - cron; scripts/lib/regions.js - REGIONS, MARCH, regionAt.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/main-menu-mgr.js - roster selection/hydration, update, onSpawn and onInput; lib/ui-character-roster.js - renderCharacterRoster.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-main-menu.js - renderMainMenu; lib/ui-art.js - BORDERS, DIVIDERS, frame, rule, BRASS_FILTER; lib/version.js - GAME_VERSION (0.8.1 Alpha), GAME_TITLE, versionTag.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/character-select.js - preview lifecycle, onSpawn, update and onInput; menu-camera.js - update.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js - character build/save/load, lifecycle, movement helpers, logout and onLeave.

mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-hud.js - renderTargetDisplay, renderHUD; lib/ui-menu-panel.js - esc, buildEqTooltip, eqSlot, renderCharTab, statTooltip, renderStatsTab, renderInvTab, formatCooldown, renderSpellbookTab, buildQuestTooltip, renderQuestsTab, renderWorldMapOverlay.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js - renderMainMenuSettingsOverlay, getRightHudLayout, default, renderZoneBanner, renderWASD, renderCharacterCreation.
scripts/player.js - onInput/update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - sit/onInput/update; scripts/gen/tree.js - geometry/collider.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state, character yaw and animation channels; gait samples prior-tick movement velocity.
MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots and persisted character records; character-select and main-menu-mgr own front-door transitions.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js - class action/cooldown/combat state; scripts/wolves.js owns pack AI and den/death timers.
scripts/quest-player.js - per-player quest, tally, inventory/xp/dialog/cache state and timber interaction; woodcutting.js owns tree fall/regrowth presentation.
scripts/vendor.js and scripts/lib/economy.js - purse transactions and coin ledger movement; vendor handles incoming coin events.
scripts/townsfolk.js - resident idle/facing state; quest-player owns per-player dialogue sequence and quest progress.
MMORPG ui.js and lib/ui-*.js - render from player/mod state; panels do not own persistent character data.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → main gameplay lifecycle.
main-menu-mgr loads the current room's SQL roster and refreshes population/character counts; a stuck _leavingMenu resets to title after 15 seconds from when leaving starts.

main-menu-mgr onSpawn repairs stale characterCreated state at the Realm Gate when not leaving, creating or playing → clears characterCreated, retains _hasCharacter/_dataLoaded and menuView → menu UI displays title rather than gameplay HUD.
Realm menu pick/join → main-menu-mgr api.cross to selected room's main-menu-land; routing validates requested room, then last room, then main using realms.yml.
scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js read realms.yml; each room cron writes player count to realm_pulse, which realm-save reads for roster UI.
Menu camera update frames the main-menu-land causeway/gate locally per player's screen; it is distinct from gameplay and creation cameras.
Character creation race/class → mod lib/races.js race start and character state → player.js/realm-save upsert to realm characters table; saved identity includes realm and slot.
templates/player.js → humanoid-locomotion → player → Vanguard → Arcanist → Pathfinder → quest-player → vendor; preserve this order and shared inputs.
moveX/moveZ/jump and orbit/steer/autorun → player.js and wow-move.js room-local intent → body motion under place gravity.
Attack/cast inputs → class abilities and scripts/lib/missiles.js → targets/wolves; wolf slow/hit state is consumed by wolves.js.
Interact/quest inputs → quest-player resolves quest NPC, talker, readable, cache or timber; quest-data/quests.yml drives accept/complete and UI actions.
main/config.yaml terrain layers bind geometry scripts to scripted looks; ui.js composes lib/ui-* renderers, including shared brass frame/rule helpers from ui-art.js for HUD and windows.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/house.js, hamlet.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, farm.js, windmill*, frontier.js, briar.js, quarry.js and reach-* - builders recur across placed instances, varied by kind, seed and dimensions.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, mushroom.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter geometry reused by place bindings, varied by layer density, scale, seed or per-item params.
scripts/gen/tree.js with scripts/tree-look.js - painted bark and alpha-cut foliage recur in forest layers and placed scatters, varied by pine/oak/giantpine/twisted/dead kind and LOD.
scripts/flower.js and mushroom.js with their look materials - painted wildflower frames and mushroom caps are varied by frame/cap params in terrain scatter.
MMORPG player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle registered by mod.json.
MMORPG camera.js/camera-creation.js and menu-camera.js - gameplay, creation-preview and per-screen menu framing camera paths with phase/place guards.
MMORPG lib/ui-*.js - modular renderers composed by ui.js for HUD, menu/roster, quests, vendor, inventory, map, character and settings; shared frame/rule styling varies by panel.

scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js; wolves.js, quest-player.js, townsfolk.js, vendor.js and woodcutting.js - combat and interaction behaviors vary by class, target tags and per-player/NPC state.
migrationNotes: Money is one integer copper amount; 100 copper = 1 silver and 100 silver = 1 gold. Route transactions through economy/coin handling to keep purse, ledger and UI aligned.
templates/player.js behavior order is significant: locomotion before movement, then classes, quests and vendor; gait samples prior-tick velocity.
Movement intent/locomotion scratch is room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity while place config owns gravity.
Realm sources differ: routing and pulse read scripts/lib/data/realms.yml, while realm-save.js hardcodes room IDs; keep roster, route and save identifiers aligned.
Persisted character fields must travel through player.js build/load data and realm-save signatures while preserving the (user, realm, slot) key; legacy storage import is main-realm-only.
Tree leaf look wraps card UVs with fract and cuts by the minimum of painted mask and texture alpha (alphaTest 0.45); retain the geometry/material UV bands and params.kind alignment.
